text.content: A platform justification that cannot be defended against alternatives is a preference. The comparison matrix forces the kind of honest, criteria-based evaluation that distinguishes an architectural decision from a default choice. Documenting why the alternatives were less appropriate is as important as documenting why the chosen platform was a good fit because it is the alternatives analysis that makes the argument credible to a technical stakeholder who could have made a different choice.
